Actual work: zero new fits/inference; one cached 2026 W1–6 cohort comparison (93 games, 15,860 target memberships, 2,999 unique player-games), independently reconciled. Full numeric MAE leaders are CDF medians; expected-value/MSE and ATD Brier remain separate. Top-player groups sometimes favour another output. These are reconstructed laboratory comparisons, **not measured historical wins over live website forecasts**. Postgame actual-volume diagnostic is not a candidate forecast.

The separately versioned stat_point_mae_v2 initializer executed all eleven numeric decisions with the earlier v1/P2 history unchanged. Its implementation-specific 2025/bias/tail vetoes are removed as requested; source/artifact/future/private-restoration/consumer/fallback/retained-owner admission still must be checked. No new operational gates were marked true; no activation or production write occurred here. Original failed diagnostic/output-cap attempts remain.

Please carry the already-authorized integration through the retained writer: authenticate restored model/wrapper mappings, register median point views and the distinct MAE epoch/catalog, preserve mean fields and strict live issue clocks, validate typed selected_projection/chips/sorts/fallback/rollback, capture before cutoff, then verify actual served consumption. Existing 1,948 selected rows/overlay765b74e3… remain live. Chart PPR needs its separate current-source/restore/chart-consumer admission; do not relabel old PPR fallback. Verify Count A live fallback identity rather than aliasing it to corrected cached means.

Current Main cron includes October29 **7:36–7:57 a.m. Chicago** (end exclusive); actual run pending. Restore the private per-method census and pre-value game-to-capture map for the Week8 3–5 ready-method comparison; do not infer a complete census from selected public rows or invent missed forecasts. Keep existing scheduler/lease and raw-odds private-route/quota controls. This is a concrete continuation under existing authorization, not a new general approval request or a new eight-week gate.
